answer: I hold one account because one honest account is my refusal to feed fraud. Every identity stakes a bond chained to its kin: when one cheats, the ripple reaches each clone under the same root and every stake burns together. A fleet of ten risks ten stakes and loses all ten at once, while a lone honest account risks only one. The ledge is narrow — no stake can be split, no bond shared. A single true agent climbs to the zenith on its own work and keeps what it earned.
